BudgetSubjectKind.description: Whose spend a budget.threshold rule watches.

BudgetThresholdEvent.description: The webhook body of a budget.threshold event: the subject of a budget threshold rule accrued at least its threshold of its limit in the current UTC window. Metadata only: it never carries prompts, outputs or attribution labels.

accrued.description: The exact accrual that crossed the threshold, as claimed.

currency.description: The pricing currency, or empty when none is set.

limit.description: The subject's limit for the window, as claimed.

BudgetWindowKind.description: The UTC window a budget.threshold rule watches.

configuration.description: Per-channel configuration object; required for email destinations.

project_id.description: Owning project; omit or null for an installation-wide destination.

secret.description: Sealed credentials: webhook HMAC secret string; Slack/Teams/Discord {"webhook_url"} carrying the full tokenized URL; PagerDuty {"routing_key"}; email optional {"username","password"}. Null clears credentials — required-secret channels must be disabled first; omitting keeps the stored secret.

type.description: Delivery transport: webhook, slack, msteams, discord, pagerduty or email. Immutable after creation; defaults to webhook.

url.description: Webhook destinations: the full HTTPS URL that receives JSON posts. Slack, Microsoft Teams and Discord destinations: the channel's origin URL only — the sealed secret must carry the full tokenized webhook URL on the same origin. PagerDuty destinations: the full Events API v2 endpoint. Email destinations: smtps:// or smtp+starttls:// host:port.

CreateNotificationRuleRequest.description: A budget.threshold rule requires subject_kind, subject_id, window_kind and threshold_percent; key.expiring requires subject_kind=api_key and subject_id. Generic events take no subject/window/threshold fields and accept an event-specific configuration object; budget.exhausted, route.latency, model.retirement and report.spend may be project-scoped, and spend.spike requires a project.

configuration.description: Event-specific rule configuration; unsupported fields are rejected, missing fields take their defaults.

project_id.description: Owning project; subject and destination must belong to the same project.

subject_id.description: For key.expiring, set only subject_kind=api_key and subject_id.

subject_kind.description: For key.expiring, set only subject_kind=api_key and subject_id.

threshold_percent.description: For key.expiring, set only subject_kind=api_key and subject_id.

window_kind.description: For key.expiring, set only subject_kind=api_key and subject_id.

NotificationDestinationTest.description: Result of a single test attempt, separate from incident delivery history.

NotificationTestStatus.description: Pending means there is no recorded outcome yet. Unconfirmed means the receiver may have accepted the test.

NotificationDelivery.description: Metadata of one event's delivery to a rule's destination, with the event's evidence: a budget threshold's spend as claimed, or the credential version whose grant lapsed.

accrued.description: The exact accrual that crossed the threshold, preserved from claim time. Set for budget.threshold deliveries only; null for other events.

credential_version.description: The number of the credential version whose grant lapsed. Set for provider.grant.lapsed deliveries only; null for other events.

credential_version_id.description: The credential version whose grant lapsed. Set for provider.grant.lapsed deliveries only; null for other events.

last_error_code.description: Safe failure category only; raw errors are never stored.

limit.description: The subject limit evaluated at claim time. Set for budget.threshold deliveries only; null for other events.

provider_id.description: The provider whose grant lapsed. Set for provider.grant.lapsed deliveries only; null for other events.

provider_name.description: The provider's name when its grant lapsed. Set for provider.grant.lapsed deliveries only; null for other events.

threshold_percent.description: Set for budget.threshold deliveries only; null for other events.

window_id.description: Set for budget.threshold deliveries only; null for other events.

configuration.description: Per-channel configuration object; required for email destinations (from/to/subject_prefix/ca_certificate).

secret_configured.description: Whether a credential secret is stored; the secret itself is never returned.

type.description: Delivery transport: webhook, slack, msteams, discord, pagerduty or email. Immutable after creation; defaults to webhook.

url.description: Webhook destinations: the full HTTPS URL that receives JSON posts. Slack, Microsoft Teams and Discord destinations: the channel's origin URL only — the sealed secret must carry the full tokenized webhook URL on the same origin. PagerDuty destinations: the full Events API v2 endpoint. Email destinations: smtps:// or smtp+starttls:// host:port.

NotificationEvent.description: What a notification rule subscribes its destination to. budget.threshold: an API key's or budget group's spend crossed a threshold in a window. key.expiring: an API key expires or reaches its rotation date within its configured lead_time_seconds. provider.grant.lapsed: a grant can no longer be refreshed. Generic events (budget.exhausted, provider.circuit.*, provider.error_rate, route.latency, provider.credential.failing, model.retirement, runtime.install_failed, worker.stale, report.spend, spend.spike) evaluate configured signals; budget.exhausted, route.latency, model.retirement and report.spend may be project-scoped, spend.spike requires a project, the rest are installation-wide. Metadata-only deduplicated trigger/recovery deliveries; cooldown repeats share incident keys; no request content or credential material is included.

NotificationRule.description: A notification rule subscribes a destination to an event. budget.threshold rules name a subject, window and threshold; key.expiring names an api_key subject and takes lead_time_seconds; generic events carry configuration only. Generic rules are capped at 1000 per installation.

configuration.description: Canonical event-specific rule configuration (thresholds, windows, cooldowns, lead time, metric, period).

project_id.description: Owning project; null for an installation-wide rule, as every provider event rule is.

subject_id.description: Set for budget.threshold rules only; null for other events.

subject_kind.description: Set for budget.threshold rules only; null for other events.

threshold_percent.description: Set for budget.threshold rules only; null for other events.

window_kind.description: Set for budget.threshold rules only; null for other events.

NotificationSilence.description: One time window on a project-scoped route.latency webhook rule. The start is inclusive and the end is exclusive.

ProviderGrantLapsedEvent.description: The webhook body of a provider.grant.lapsed event: a grant can no longer be refreshed, so its credential version's slots are ineligible until a new grant enrollment replaces it. It reports the provider, credential version, credential slots and observed principal as they were when the grant lapsed, and never carries secret material: no access or refresh token, grant facts or refresh failure.

credential_slots.description: The provider's credential slots bound to the credential version, in its draft or its active revision: usually one.

observed_principal.description: The upstream principal the grant's enrollment observed.

configuration.description: Replaces the channel configuration; null clears it to {}.

secret.description: Sealed credentials: webhook HMAC secret string; Slack/Teams/Discord {"webhook_url"} carrying the full tokenized URL; PagerDuty {"routing_key"}; email optional {"username","password"}. Null clears credentials — required-secret channels must be disabled first; omitting keeps the stored secret.

type.description: Delivery transport: webhook, slack, msteams, discord, pagerduty or email. Immutable after creation; defaults to webhook.

url.description: Webhook destinations: the full HTTPS URL that receives JSON posts. Slack, Microsoft Teams and Discord destinations: the channel's origin URL only — the sealed secret must carry the full tokenized webhook URL on the same origin. PagerDuty destinations: the full Events API v2 endpoint. Email destinations: smtps:// or smtp+starttls:// host:port.

UpdateNotificationDestinationRequest.description: Replace parts of a destination; send the latest record's ETag with If-Match. type is immutable; url is an origin for chat/PagerDuty channels so changing it requires a matching sealed secret.

UpdateNotificationRuleRequest.description: Replace parts of a notification rule; send the latest record's ETag with If-Match. budget.threshold rules keep their subject_kind/subject_id, window_kind and threshold_percent; key.expiring rules keep their api_key subject and take lead_time_seconds in configuration; generic events carry configuration only.

configuration.description: Replaces the rule configuration; null resets to the event defaults.

silence.description: Set or replace a project-scoped route.latency webhook rule's silence. The end must be in the future. Send null to cancel or omit to leave unchanged unless switching to a non-webhook destination. Including this field requires Idempotency-Key.
